fields.v: Proposes an approach; secondary: Review — proposes SDD as a team-level discipline with a 'methodological harness' of eight mechanisms (H1-H8) and five human-agent interaction patterns, illustrated with fictitious worked examples, nothing evaluated; built on a multivocal literature review (four databases with one search string, purposive grey literature, IC/EC stated)
fields.quote: we go into depth on one of them and propose the discipline, the artifacts, and the team-level mechanisms through which that form can be operated
fields.why: The authors say they propose the discipline, artefacts and mechanisms (methodological harness), which fits 'Proposes an approach' better than 'Conceptual', and the nature decides Q12; the described search (sources, IC/EC) could also make it a secondary study for DARE.
fields.doubt: Os autores dizem que propõem a disciplina, os artefactos e os mecanismos (o 'methodological harness' H1-H8), o que parece 'Proposes an approach' e não só 'Conceptual'. Isto muda a Q12 (N/A). Vê também a §3.2-3.4 (pág. 9-10): descrevem fontes e IC/EC; decide se fica como revisão com DARE ou mantém Q1-Q13.

fields.v: N/A: the study proposes an approach (methodological harness for SDD) and evaluates none; no tool is evaluated
fields.quote: we go into depth on one of them and propose the discipline, the artifacts, and the team-level mechanisms through which that form can be operated
fields.why: Under the 2026-11-23 rule a study that proposes an approach and evaluates none is N/A on Q12; Yes (1) holds only if the nature stays Conceptual.
fields.doubt: Se aceitares 'Proposes an approach' na natureza, a regra de 23/11 manda Q12 = N/A (propõem o harness e não avaliam nada). Se mantiveres 'Conceptual', o Sim (1) pode ficar. Decide em conjunto com a natureza.
